summary: Develop your leadership abilities with our specialized training course on organizational restructuring. Lead your team through transitions confidently.
lede: Organizational restructuring training helps leaders and specialists plan workforce changes while maintaining operational continuity. It covers assessing organizational design and workforce capacity, mapping stakeholders, applying change models such as Kotter’s 8-Step Process and ADKAR, and managing transition risks through communication plans and performance tracking.
audienceIntro: This program is essential for leaders and specialists tasked with managing the complexities of corporate evolution and workforce realignment.
modules: Workforce Planning and Span of Control
prerequisites: Participants should have at least 3 years of management experience or work in a Human Resources or Operations role. Familiarity with basic organizational charts and strategic planning concepts is recommended.
